evidence.snippet: Kelly (dressed as Carrie Bradshaw): Wow you guys look amazing.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam discuss their plans and interactions with family and friends.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Hey New York, Happy Halloween!
Pam: Thanks. My costume's getting a lot of attention.

beats.summary: Holly and Michael discuss her transfer to Nashua and their relationship.

evidence.snippet: Michael: When Corporate found out that we were dating, they decided they were going to transfer Holly back to her old branch, in Nashua, New Hampshire.
Holly: Michael is taking a personal day to move me up.

beats.summary: Pam plans a prank involving her ring with her brothers.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I asked Tom and Pete to come early so we could play a prank on Jim at lunch!
Tom: Right! That would be hilarious! We should totally dog her, about being an artist, never making any money!

beats.summary: Dwight discusses his ambition to get into Cornell and his school pride.
